This document outlines the equipment 
inspection checklist I1, which must be performed for main cooling water pump every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

The pump function is to cool the outlet Steam from LP turbine to convert the steam to 
condensate water, and also to cool the closed cooling water for accessories

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags

Check discharge quantity and pump pressure then compare it with the setting 
 value

Measure vibration level for bearing and compare it with the setting value, then 
 analyze it and determine what to do (if it is needed)
Check the temperature of the cooling water
Check the gland leakage, check the oil level
Clean the oil cooler
Grease the coupling
Check the alignment and compare it with the setting value
Check the leakage of flanges
Check the packing of the gland and repacked if required
Check bolts fixation, then retighten ( if it is needed ) .
Make test for bearings oil and add or change it ( if it is needed ) .
Check the pump casing against rust and repaint ( if it is needed )
